text:
Jamal: @channel Euro derby tonight — who's in for a tiny office pool + pizza order? :soccer: :pizza:
Marta: I'm in. 5€ entry? I'll Venmo. :thumbsup:
Sophia: Count me in too. Can we make the tiebreaker 'total goals' so it's not a coin flip?
Devon: yes to goals tiebreaker. also i have strong opinions about anchovies (i win if they show up). :grin:
Jamal: ok goals it is. Tiebreaker = total goals scored by both teams.
Ava: I'm late but want pizza only — will buy my slice if i'm not in the pool. pesto and mushroom pls. :pray:
Jamal: clicking poll — vote for pizza style + reply with your prediction (e.g., 2-1)
pollbot: POLL: "Pizza choice" — options: 1) Margherita, 2) Pepperoni, 3) Pesto & Mushroom, 4) Vegan Special
Marta: voted 1) + prediction 1-1
Sophia: voted 3) + prediction 2-1
Devon: voted 2) + prediction 3-2 (anchovies cameo)
Ava: voted 3) + prediction 0-2 (yikes)
Jamal: tallying — looks like Margherita and Pesto tied, but majority want Pesto? okay final order: 2 Margherita, 3 Pesto & Mushroom, 1 Pepperoni, 1 Vegan Special
Marta: i'll Venmo @Jamal 5€ in a bit. good luck everyone :four_leaf_clover:
Sophia: reminder — watch at the lounge at 7:30? small TV, bring noise if you're loud.
Devon: i'll bring celebratory confetti only if my underdog score hits. :laughing:
Jamal: great — final logistics: lounge at 7:15 for pizza setup, pool entry closes at 7:25. Post your score predictions in this thread before then.
Ava: posted my prediction. also shoutout to facilities for the couch setup earlier, that was clutch. :clap:
pollbot: REMINDER: Pool entry closes in 10 minutes. Good luck!
Jamal: thanks all — see you tonight. may the best bracket-free footie gambler win. :soccer: :pizza:
